message.text: The repository contains no per-user API rate-limiting middleware. The registered middleware includes Recover, CORS, and API authentication.

r02.
There is no per-user API rate-limiting middleware and no request-limit configuration. Echo only registers `Recover` and CORS (`server/server.go`); API auth is a separate interceptor/gateway middleware (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go`), not a rate limiter. Nothing in the Go code or `go.mod` implements quotas or 429 throttling.
